thread:
Nadia P.: opening incident — ap-east embed-store is rate-throttling reads leading to 429s and some 5xxs for streaming-search and realtime-similarity. Posting status: https://status.redwood.inference/incident/1978000001
SRE-Bot: ALERT: embed-store::throttle_rate > 70% (2m) | 5xx rate 4.6% | 429 rate 9.1% | p99 latency 4.9s | affected: hosted-embeddings-ap-east, streaming-search
Tom H. (oncall): grabbing this. Initial indicators: a large ingestion job started at 09:07 UTC hitting hot key ranges + per-tenant burst budget exhaustion after yesterday's token-bucket refactor. Also seeing SDK clients retrying aggressively (no jitter) which amplifies load.
Jo M.: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily raise per-tenant burst cap for ap-east, 2) enable ingress-level backpressure to reject oversized batched read requests, 3) spin a hot-read shard and move offending hot keys. Starting actions now.
Edge-Team: enabling backpressure rule: `curl -X POST https://admin.ap-east.edge/rules -d '{"rule":"reject_large_batch","threshold":2000}'`
Tom H.: scaling embed-store read nodes: `kubectl -n embed scale statefulset/embed-store-ap-east --replicas=6` (4->6). Spinning hot-shard: `./infra/reshard --pool ap-east --keys-file hot_keys.txt`
SRE-Bot: POST-MITIG: throttle_rate -> 28% (5m after), 429 -> 1.2%, 5xx -> 0.8%, p99 latency -> 1.6s
Jo M.: follow-ups: capture offending ingestion job id and contact the owner; add SDK client guidance to recommend jittered exponential backoff; revert token-bucket param change or roll forward with stricter canary.
Customer Success: pinged 12 impacted customers and opened tickets for the top 5. Drafting an upstream note for customers who saw >1% errors.
Product Ops: severity: SEV-2. Impact window estimate: 09:07-09:22 UTC. Will post banner and targeted emails. Drafting short status banner: "APAC customers may have seen elevated 429/5xx for embeddings and streaming search between 09:07-09:22 UTC. Mitigation applied and services recovering."
Tom H.: leaving runbook and log pointers: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/embed-throttling and logs: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=container AND labels.cluster_name=embed-ap-east" --limit 1000`
Nadia P.: status -> recovering. Monitoring for 30m, will escalate to SEV-1 if error rates spike above 2% for >5m. Postmortem placeholder: https://redwood-internal/docs/incidents/1978000001-postmortem. Thanks all for rapid response :thumbsup:
